name.zh-CN: 复合手术床（碳纤维浮动床面）

description.zh-CN: 复合手术室专用手术床：单立柱底座、可透 X 线的长碳纤维浮动床面（头脚全程可透视）、分节软垫、侧轨、双侧臂板、麻醉头架及床旁铅橡胶防护帘。
description.en: Hybrid-OR table: single pedestal, long radiolucent carbon-fibre floating top for head-to-toe imaging, padded segments, side rails, arm boards, an anaesthesia screen frame and a table-side lead-rubber curtain.

usage.zh-CN: 按术式摆放体位并固定约束带，受压部位加衬垫；成像前将床面移入 C 形臂的投照范围，并确认铅帘与铅屏风到位。
usage.en: Position and strap the patient, pad pressure points; float the top into the C-arm's field before imaging and check that the lead curtain and shield are in place.

description.zh-CN: 跨越手术床的可升降器械托盘，铺无菌巾并摆放当前步骤常用器械。
description.en: Height-adjustable tray that reaches over the table, draped sterile and laid with the instruments for the current step.

name.zh-CN: 机器人落地式血管造影 C 形臂

description.zh-CN: 复合手术室的机器人落地式血管造影系统：多轴机械臂带动 C 形臂（球管与平板探测器），停放位不占用手术区，可在术中完成血管造影、透视和锥形束 CT。
description.en: Robotic floor-mounted angiography system for the hybrid OR: a multi-axis robot carries the C-arm (tube and flat-panel detector), parks clear of the sterile field and delivers angiography, fluoroscopy and cone-beam CT during surgery.

usage.zh-CN: 由放射技师在控制室或床旁操作：先确认术区人员佩戴铅衣、铅屏风就位，再进行透视、数字减影血管造影或锥形束 CT；遵循辐射防护最优化（ALARA）原则。
usage.en: Run by the radiographer from the control room or tableside: confirm lead aprons and the ceiling shield first, then acquire fluoroscopy, DSA or cone-beam CT; keep doses as low as reasonably achievable (ALARA).

prompt.zh-CN: E · 使用血管造影 C 形臂

description.zh-CN: 双筒高压注射器（造影剂与生理盐水），立柱式，带触摸控制屏，与血管造影系统联动。
description.en: Dual-syringe power injector (contrast and saline) on a pedestal with a touch-screen controller, synchronised with the angiography system.

name.zh-CN: 排气并上锁（确认管路无气泡）
name.en: Purge air and arm (no bubbles in the line)

name.zh-CN: 透视下注射（需穿铅衣、铅屏风就位）
name.en: Inject under fluoroscopy (lead apron on, shield in place)

description.zh-CN: 吊顶悬挂的铅当量丙烯酸防护屏，配多关节臂；可移至球管与术者之间，减少散射线剂量。
description.en: Ceiling-suspended lead-acrylic shield on an articulated arm, swung between the patient and the operator to cut scattered radiation.

name.zh-CN: 已就位（术者与球管之间）
name.en: in place (between the operator and the tube)
Bring between the operator and the tube

description.zh-CN: 挂墙式铅衣架，挂有铅围裙、铅颈围（甲状腺防护）和铅眼镜，按尺码分类。
description.en: Wall rack with lead aprons, thyroid collars and lead glasses sorted by size.

description.zh-CN: 手术台正上方的单向流（低紊流置换流）送风天花：末端 HEPA 高效过滤器、均流膜面和周边导流玻璃裙边；3.2 × 3.2 m 送风面覆盖手术台与器械台。对应 GB 50333 Ⅰ级（手术区 ISO 5 级）、DIN 1946-4 Ⅰa 级（TAV）和 HTM 03-01 超净通风（≤ 10 CFU/m³）的设计意图。
description.en: Unidirectional (low-turbulence displacement) supply ceiling over the table: terminal HEPA filters, a flow-equalising face and perimeter glass skirts; the 3.2 × 3.2 m supply face covers the table and the instrument tables. Design intent: GB 50333 Class I (ISO 5 at the operating zone), DIN 1946-4 class Ia (TAV) and HTM 03-01 ultra-clean ventilation (≤ 10 CFU/m³).

description.zh-CN: 手术台上方的单向流送风天花，末端 HEPA 过滤，送风面覆盖手术区；适用于 GB 50333 Ⅱ级洁净手术室与常规通风手术室（ASHRAE 170：手术台上方送风阵列、总换气 ≥ 20 次/h）。
description.en: Unidirectional supply ceiling with terminal HEPA filters over the operating zone, for GB 50333 Class II rooms and conventionally ventilated ORs (ASHRAE 170: a primary supply array over the table, ≥ 20 total air changes per hour).

description.zh-CN: 吊顶式麻醉吊塔：氧气、医用空气、笑气、负压吸引和麻醉废气排放（AGSS）终端，双层设备托架和多路电源插座（含隔离电源），吊臂可旋转升降。
description.en: Ceiling-mounted anaesthesia supply pendant: oxygen, medical air, nitrous oxide, vacuum and anaesthetic gas scavenging (AGSS) outlets, two equipment shelves and power sockets (including isolated-power circuits) on a rotating, height-adjustable arm.

usage.zh-CN: 从吊塔取氧气和负压吸引：调节吸引负压并检查吸引瓶，麻醉机接 AGSS 废气排放；设备停放在托架上，地面不留拖线。
usage.en: Draw oxygen and suction from the pendant: set the vacuum and check the canister, connect the anaesthesia machine to the AGSS scavenging outlet; keep equipment on the shelves and cables off the floor.

prompt.zh-CN: E · 使用吊塔气体终端

description.zh-CN: 吊顶式外科设备吊塔：托架上放置高频电刀（电外科工作站）和气腹机，配医用气体、负压和电源/数据接口。
description.en: Ceiling-mounted surgical pendant carrying the electrosurgical generator and the insufflator, with medical gas, vacuum, power and data outlets.

usage.zh-CN: 电刀负极板贴于肌肉丰厚、干燥部位，使用前确认功率设置；气腹压力按术式设定并持续观察。
usage.en: Place the electrosurgical return electrode on dry, well-perfused muscle and check the power settings before use; set the insufflation pressure for the procedure and watch it throughout.

prompt.zh-CN: E · 电刀主机 / 气腹机

name.zh-CN: 贴负极板并确认接触质量监测（REM/CQM）
name.en: Place the return electrode and confirm contact-quality monitoring (REM/CQM)

name.zh-CN: 启用电刀输出（需烟雾排除器运行）
name.en: Enable generator output (needs the smoke evacuator running)
Remove the return electrode and check the skin

name.zh-CN: 吊臂式 4K 医用显示器

description.zh-CN: 吊臂悬挂的 55 英寸 4K 医用显示器，可显示腔镜图像、PACS 影像、导航或造影画面（数字化一体化手术室视频路由）。
description.en: 55-inch 4K surgical display on a ceiling spring arm, routed by the integrated-OR video system: endoscopy, PACS images, navigation or angiography.

description.zh-CN: 嵌墙安装的 55 英寸医用显示屏，显示 PACS 影像、电子病历和一体化手术室的视频源。
description.en: Flush-mounted 55-inch clinical display for PACS images, the electronic record and integrated-OR video sources.

description.zh-CN: 墙嵌式手术室控制面板：显示室温（设计目标 20–24 °C）、相对湿度、对走廊的压差（正压/负压）、层流运行状态和医用气体报警，并带手术计时、麻醉计时、无影灯与照明控制。
description.en: Flush OR control panel: room temperature (design target 20–24 °C), relative humidity, pressure differential to the corridor (positive or negative), laminar-flow status and medical-gas alarms, plus surgical and anaesthesia timers and light controls.

name.zh-CN: 夜间节能模式（保持正压）
核对环境参数（换气、压差、温湿度、层流、气体报警）
name.en: Check the room (air changes, pressure, temperature, humidity, laminar flow, gas alarms)

name.zh-CN: 切换手术模式（开台前至少 15 分钟）
name.en: Switch to operating mode (at least 15 min before the case)

description.zh-CN: 负压/隔离手术室门旁的房间压差监测仪：显示相对相邻房间的压差，压力梯度失效时声光报警。
description.en: Room pressure monitor beside the isolation-room door: shows the differential to the adjacent space and alarms when the pressure cascade fails.

description.zh-CN: 世界卫生组织手术安全核查表墙板：麻醉前核查（Sign in）、切皮前暂停核查（Time out）、离室前核查（Sign out）三个阶段。
description.en: Wall board with the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist: Sign in before induction, Time out before skin incision and Sign out before the patient leaves the room.

name.zh-CN: 切皮前暂停核查完成（Time out）
Sign in：核对身份、术式、部位标记、过敏、气道与失血风险
name.en: Sign in: identity, procedure, site marking, allergies, airway and blood-loss risk

name.zh-CN: Time out：全员暂停，确认患者、术式、部位，预防性抗菌药与影像（需切皮前清点完成）
name.en: Time out: the whole team pauses — patient, procedure, site, antibiotic prophylaxis, imaging (needs the baseline count)

name.zh-CN: Sign out：术式记录、清点相符、标本标识、设备问题（需最终清点相符）
name.en: Sign out: procedure recorded, counts reconciled, specimens labelled, equipment problems (needs the reconciled count)

name.zh-CN: 下一台手术：新的核查表

description.zh-CN: 手术部控制台的大屏：各手术间当日排程、当前阶段（准备 / 麻醉 / 手术 / 复苏 / 清洁）、预计时间和急诊插台。
description.en: Control-desk wall screen: today's list for every OR, the current phase (set-up / anaesthesia / surgery / recovery / cleaning), expected times and emergency add-ons.

description.zh-CN: 符合 ISO 80601-2-13 的麻醉工作站：电子流量计、双挥发罐、循环回路与二氧化碳吸收罐、具备多种通气模式的麻醉呼吸机、呼气末气体监测和独立监护屏。
description.en: Anaesthesia workstation built to ISO 80601-2-13: electronic flowmeters, two vaporisers, a circle system with CO₂ absorber, an anaesthesia ventilator with ICU-grade modes, end-tidal gas monitoring and a separate monitor screen.

usage.zh-CN: 使用前完成自检与回路检漏，设定新鲜气体流量和挥发罐浓度；诱导插管后选择通气模式，持续监测呼气末二氧化碳、吸入/呼出麻醉气体浓度与气道压力。
usage.en: Complete the self-test and leak test before use, set fresh gas flows and vaporiser concentration; after induction and intubation choose a ventilation mode and watch end-tidal CO₂, inspired/expired agent and airway pressures.

description.zh-CN: 按困难气道处理流程分层抽屉（A 面罩通气与插管 / B 声门上气道 / C 面罩通气抢救 / D 紧急颈前气道）的推车，顶部配可视喉镜，另有纤维支气管镜、探条和环甲膜切开套件。
description.en: Trolley with drawers in difficult-airway-algorithm order (Plan A intubation, B supraglottic airway, C face-mask rescue, D emergency front-of-neck access), a video laryngoscope on top, a flexible scope, bougies and a cricothyroidotomy kit.

name.zh-CN: 手术机器人床旁机械臂系统

description.zh-CN: 机器人辅助手术系统的床旁机械臂车：立柱与悬吊平台带四条器械臂（3 条器械臂 + 1 条内镜臂），对接穿刺器后由主刀在控制台远程操控。
description.en: Patient-side cart of the robotic surgical system: a column and boom carrying four arms (three instrument arms and one endoscope arm), docked to the ports and driven from the surgeon console.

usage.zh-CN: 由床旁助手对接穿刺器并安装器械，主刀在控制台操作；紧急中转开放手术时按预案快速撤离机械臂。
usage.en: The bedside assistant docks the ports and loads the instruments while the surgeon operates from the console; rehearse the emergency undocking drill for conversion to open surgery.

prompt.zh-CN: E · 手术机器人机械臂

name.zh-CN: 手术机器人医生控制台

description.zh-CN: 主刀医生控制台：三维高清立体视窗、主控手柄、脚踏（能量、离合、镜头）和人机工程扶手。
description.en: Surgeon console: 3D HD stereo viewer, master controllers, foot pedals (energy, clutch, camera) and an ergonomic armrest.

description.zh-CN: 机器人系统的视频车：三维内镜图像处理、光源、电外科能量平台和触摸显示屏，供台上助手和巡回护士观看。
description.en: Vision cart of the robotic system: 3D endoscope image processing, light source, energy platform and a touch display for the bedside team.

description.zh-CN: 腹腔镜塔：4K/3D 摄像主机、LED 冷光源、二氧化碳气腹机、影像记录和 32 英寸监视器，配医用隔离变压器。
description.en: Laparoscopy tower: 4K/3D camera control unit, LED light source, CO₂ insufflator, image recorder and a 32-inch monitor on a medical isolation transformer.

usage.zh-CN: 连接光缆和摄像头，白平衡后入镜；气腹压力按术式和患者情况设定，并留意高压报警。
usage.en: Connect the light cable and camera, white-balance, then insert the scope; set the insufflation pressure for the procedure and patient, and respond to over-pressure alarms.

name.zh-CN: 气腹中（压力按术式设定）

name.zh-CN: 体外循环机（人工心肺机）

description.zh-CN: 体外循环机：五个滚压泵头、膜式氧合器、静脉回流储血罐、变温水箱接口、压力/流量/温度监测屏和气泡探测。
description.en: Cardiopulmonary bypass machine: five roller-pump heads, a membrane oxygenator, venous reservoir, heater-cooler connections, pressure/flow/temperature display and bubble detection.

usage.zh-CN: 由灌注师管理：预充排气、核对抗凝（ACT）后转机，监测灌注流量、压力、温度和静脉储血罐液面。
usage.en: Run by the perfusionist: prime and de-air the circuit, confirm anticoagulation (ACT) before going on bypass, and watch flows, pressures, temperatures and the reservoir level.

description.zh-CN: 术中自体血回收机：回收术野出血，离心洗涤后回输浓缩红细胞，用于大出血风险手术（心脏、骨科、产科大出血）。
description.en: Cell saver: collects shed blood from the field, centrifuges and washes it, and returns concentrated red cells, for operations with major blood-loss risk (cardiac, orthopaedic, obstetric haemorrhage).

description.zh-CN: 光学手术导航：红外立体定位相机追踪器械与患者参考架，将器械位置叠加到术前 CT/MRI 或术中锥形束 CT 上（神经外科、脊柱、关节置换）。
description.en: Optical navigation: an infrared stereo camera tracks instruments and the patient reference array and overlays them on pre-operative CT/MRI or intra-operative cone-beam CT (neurosurgery, spine, arthroplasty).

description.zh-CN: 落地式手术显微镜：平衡臂、电磁锁、双人双目镜筒、荧光造影模块和高清摄像输出，用于神经外科、脊柱和显微外科。
description.en: Floor-stand operating microscope: balanced arm with electromagnetic brakes, binocular heads for surgeon and assistant, fluorescence module and HD video output, for neuro, spine and microsurgery.

description.zh-CN: 新生儿复苏单元：辐射加热器、可倾斜复苏床、空氧混合器与氧流量计、T 组合复苏器、负压吸引、Apgar 计时器和血氧探头，剖宫产手术间必备。
description.en: Neonatal resuscitation unit: radiant heater, tilting bed, air–oxygen blender and flowmeter, T-piece resuscitator, suction, Apgar timer and an SpO₂ probe; standard equipment in an obstetric theatre.

usage.zh-CN: 分娩前预热辐射台并检查氧源、吸引和 T 组合复苏器；新生儿出生后擦干保暖，按新生儿复苏流程评估呼吸与心率，记录 Apgar 评分。
usage.en: Pre-warm the unit and check oxygen, suction and the T-piece before delivery; dry and warm the baby, assess breathing and heart rate by the newborn life-support algorithm and record Apgar scores.

description.zh-CN: 充气式患者保温系统主机，经软管连接保温毯，围术期维持核心体温、预防意外低体温。
description.en: Forced-air patient warming unit feeding a warming blanket by hose, to keep core temperature up and prevent inadvertent perioperative hypothermia.

description.zh-CN: 双温区加温柜：上层加温毯，下层加温冲洗液与输液（按设定温度保存），玻璃门可视。
description.en: Two-zone warming cabinet: blankets above, irrigation and IV fluids below at set temperatures, behind glass doors.

description.zh-CN: 不锈钢网格存放架：无菌器械包（双层包布）、硬质灭菌盒和一次性无菌物品，距地 ≥ 20 cm、距顶 ≥ 50 cm 存放，先进先出。
description.en: Stainless wire rack with wrapped instrument sets, rigid sterilisation containers and single-use sterile supplies, kept off the floor and away from the ceiling, first in, first out.

description.zh-CN: 闭式不锈钢器械配送车：按手术排程由消毒供应中心备齐一台手术的器械与耗材，经洁净电梯送至无菌核心区；术后污染器械密闭送回去污区。
description.en: Closed stainless case cart: CSSD picks the instruments and supplies for one case to the theatre list and sends it up the clean lift to the sterile core; used instruments go back closed to decontamination.

description.zh-CN: 无菌核心区的台式快速压力蒸汽灭菌器，仅用于术中意外污染的单件器械紧急再处理（不替代消毒供应中心的常规灭菌），每锅记录生物/化学监测结果。
description.en: Benchtop immediate-use steam steriliser in the sterile core, only for urgent reprocessing of a single dropped instrument during a case (never a substitute for routine CSSD sterilisation); each cycle is logged with its indicators.

name.zh-CN: 双门脉动真空压力蒸汽灭菌器

description.zh-CN: 消毒供应中心的双门（穿墙式）脉动真空压力蒸汽灭菌器：包装区装载、无菌物品存放区卸载，门互锁；每锅做 B-D 试验与化学/生物监测并可追溯（ISO 17665）。
description.en: CSSD pass-through pre-vacuum steam steriliser: loaded from the packing room, unloaded into sterile storage, doors interlocked; Bowie-Dick test, chemical and biological indicators and full traceability (ISO 17665).

name.zh-CN: B-D 空气排除试验（每日首锅）
name.en: Bowie-Dick air-removal test (first cycle of the day)

name.zh-CN: 运行 134 °C 脉动真空程序（EN 285、ISO 17665）
核对物理参数与化学/生物指示物后放行
name.en: Check physical parameters and chemical / biological indicators, release the load

description.zh-CN: 去污区与包装区之间的穿墙式清洗消毒器：器械在去污区装载，经清洗、湿热消毒（A0 值）和干燥后从包装区取出（ISO 15883）。
description.en: Pass-through washer-disinfector between decontamination and packing: loaded dirty side, washed, thermally disinfected (A0) and dried, unloaded clean side (ISO 15883).

name.zh-CN: 程序完成：A0 ≥ 3000，已干燥（清洁侧）

name.en: Load instruments on the dirty side

description.zh-CN: 器械检查包装台：带光源放大镜检查清洗质量与功能，按器械清单组装、双层包装或装入硬质容器，封口并打印追溯条码。
description.en: Inspection and packing bench: illuminated magnifier for cleanliness and function checks, sets assembled to the tray list, double-wrapped or containerised, sealed and labelled with a traceability barcode.

name.zh-CN: 去污清洗槽（含超声清洗）

description.zh-CN: 去污区的双槽手工清洗台与超声清洗机，配高压水枪和气枪，用于预处理和复杂器械（管腔器械）的清洗。
description.en: Twin-bowl manual decontamination sink with an ultrasonic cleaner, water and air guns, for pre-cleaning and complex (lumened) instruments.

description.zh-CN: 双人外科刷手池：感应/膝控水龙头、外科手消毒液和刷手海绵分配器、刷手计时器，水槽深且防溅。
description.en: Twin-station scrub trough: sensor/knee-operated taps, surgical hand-rub and scrub-sponge dispensers, a scrub timer and a deep, splash-proof basin.

description.zh-CN: 挂墙式防护用品站：一次性手术衣、无菌手套、医用防护口罩（N95/FFP3）、护目镜与面屏、鞋套，配穿戴步骤图与穿衣镜。
description.en: Wall PPE station: single-use gowns, sterile gloves, respirators (N95/FFP3), goggles and face shields, overshoes, a donning sequence chart and a mirror.

description.zh-CN: 刷卡领取的洗手衣自动发放机（按尺码），回收口收集换下的洗手衣，减少更衣室堆放和交叉污染。
description.en: Card-operated scrub-suit dispenser (by size) with a return chute for worn scrubs, cutting clutter and cross-contamination in the changing room.

description.zh-CN: 更衣室中划分外区与内区的跨越凳：坐下脱外出鞋放入外侧鞋柜，转身跨过后换上手术室专用鞋。
description.en: Step-over bench dividing the outer and inner sides of the changing room: sit, put outdoor shoes in the outer rack, swing over and put on theatre shoes.

name.zh-CN: 污物处置池与便器清洗机

description.zh-CN: 污物间的冲洗池（污物处置池）和便器清洗消毒机，用于倾倒和处理体液、术后污物。
description.en: Sluice (flushing rim sink) and bedpan washer-disinfector in the soiled utility room, for disposing of body fluids and post-operative waste.

description.zh-CN: 分类收集站：感染性医疗废物（黄色）、锐器盒、病理性废物、生活垃圾和污染布类，均为脚踏加盖。
description.en: Segregated collection: infectious clinical waste (yellow), sharps, pathological waste, general waste and soiled linen, all with foot-operated lids.

description.zh-CN: 地面红线：标示半限制区的边界，越线必须穿戴洗手衣、帽子（及按要求佩戴口罩）。
description.en: Red floor line marking the semi-restricted boundary: beyond it, scrubs and a cap (and a mask where required) are mandatory.

description.zh-CN: 靠近地面的回风/排风口，成对设在房间对角，使送风自上而下流经手术区后排出。
description.en: Return/exhaust grille near the floor, in pairs at opposite corners, so supply air flows down through the operating zone before it leaves.

name.zh-CN: 医用气体区域阀箱与报警器
name.en: Medical-gas zone valve box & area alarm

description.zh-CN: 医用气体区域阀箱（氧气、医用空气、笑气、负压、废气排放）与区域报警器：压力异常时声光报警，紧急情况下可关断本区供气。
description.en: Medical-gas zone valve box (oxygen, medical air, nitrous oxide, vacuum, scavenging) and area alarm: alarms on abnormal pressure and lets staff isolate the zone in an emergency.

description.zh-CN: 术中快速冰冻切片机：在 -20 °C 左右的冷冻箱内切片，快速染色后由病理医师在显微镜下出具术中诊断。
description.en: Cryostat for intra-operative frozen sections: tissue is cut in a chamber at about −20 °C, rapidly stained and read under the microscope by the pathologist.

description.zh-CN: 手术部专用组合式空调机组：新风/回风段、粗中效过滤、表冷与加热盘管、干蒸汽加湿、EC 风机墙和中效末级过滤；送风经风管至各手术间吊顶的末端高效过滤器（HEPA）。
description.en: Dedicated OR air-handling unit: fresh/return air section, pre- and bag filters, cooling and heating coils, dry-steam humidifier, EC fan wall and final filters; ducted to the terminal HEPA filters in each OR ceiling.

name.zh-CN: 安全手术刀（3 号刀柄 + 10/15 号刀片）

description.zh-CN: 可回缩护套的安全手术刀：刀柄与刀片配合尺寸符合 ISO 7740，刀片为马氏体不锈钢（ISO 7153-1、ASTM F899-23），护套单手推出、用后回缩，刀柄激光直接标记 UDI（欧盟 MDR 附录 VI、21 CFR 801.45）。锐器经中立区传递（AORN），不手递手。
description.en: Safety scalpel with a retractable shield: handle-to-blade fit to ISO 7740, martensitic stainless blade (ISO 7153-1, ASTM F899-23), one-handed shield advance and retraction, UDI laser-marked on the handle (EU MDR Annex VI, 21 CFR 801.45). Pass sharps through a neutral zone, never hand to hand (AORN).

usage.zh-CN: 切皮前必须完成 WHO 暂停核查，手术间处于手术模式，术者已外科手消毒并穿无菌手术衣、戴无菌手套。
usage.en: Before skin incision: the WHO time-out done, the room in operating mode, the surgeon scrubbed, gowned and gloved.

name.zh-CN: 消毒供应中心再处理（清洗消毒→检查包装→灭菌）
name.en: Reprocess in the CSSD (wash → inspect & pack → sterilise)

description.zh-CN: 碳化钨镶片钳口的持针器（金色手柄识别），关节器械通用要求与试验按 ISO 7151:2024，耐高压蒸汽与腐蚀按 ISO 13402:2025 验证，UDI 直接标记。
description.en: Needle holder with tungsten-carbide jaw inserts (gold handles), articulated-instrument requirements and tests to ISO 7151:2024, autoclave and corrosion resistance verified to ISO 13402:2025, UDI direct-marked.

usage.zh-CN: 先夹针（针体后 1/3），再缝合；锐器计数。
usage.en: Load the needle (at the back third of the body), then suture; count the needles.

description.en: Single-use monopolar pencil with an integrated smoke-evacuation shroud (piped to the smoke evacuator), hand-switched cut and coag; used with an IEC 60601-2-2:2017+A1:2023 generator with return-electrode contact-quality monitoring.

usage.zh-CN: 电刀主机就绪（负极板已监测）且烟雾排除器运行时才能激发（AORN：所有手术烟雾都应排出并过滤）。
usage.en: Activates only with the generator ready (return electrode monitored) and the smoke evacuator running (AORN: evacuate and filter all surgical smoke).

description.en: Abdominal swabs with an X-ray-detectable thread and an RFID tag, ten to a pack; counted at the JAOM guideline points, with RF detection as the count adjunct (AORN).

name.zh-CN: 硬质无菌器械盒（基础剖腹器械包）

description.zh-CN: 带过滤器与一次性封签的硬质灭菌容器（EN 868-8:2018），内放化学指示物（ISO 11140-1 第 5 类）与器械清单；开包前核对封签、外部指示物和有效期，开包后核对内部指示物。
description.en: Rigid sterilisation container with filters and tamper-evident seals (EN 868-8:2018), a class 5 chemical integrator (ISO 11140-1) and the tray list inside; check seal, external indicator and expiry before opening and the internal integrator after.

usage.zh-CN: 先核对（封签、指示物、有效期），再在无菌区内无菌开包；用毕关盒送消毒供应中心再处理。
usage.en: Verify (seal, indicators, expiry), then open aseptically inside the sterile field; close after use and send to the CSSD for reprocessing.

name.zh-CN: 加强型无菌手术衣（AAMI 4 级）

description.zh-CN: 加强型无菌手术衣：关键区达到 AAMI PB70:2022 4 级屏障，同时满足 EN 13795-1:2019 高性能要求；外科手消毒后在无菌区内由洗手护士协助穿戴。
description.en: Reinforced sterile gown: AAMI PB70:2022 Level 4 barrier in the critical zones and EN 13795-1:2019 high-performance; put on in the sterile field after the surgical scrub, helped by the scrub nurse.

name.zh-CN: 无粉无菌外科手套（双层带穿孔指示）
name.en: Powder-free sterile surgical gloves (double-glove indicator system)

description.zh-CN: 无粉灭菌外科手套，内层彩色穿孔指示（EN 455 系列、ASTM D3577），按 AORN 建议双层佩戴。
description.en: Powder-free sterile surgical gloves with a coloured perforation-indicator underglove (EN 455 series, ASTM D3577), double-gloved as AORN recommends.

name.zh-CN: 铅衣（0.5 mm 铅当量，环绕式）

description.zh-CN: 环绕式铅/无铅复合防护围裙，正面 0.5 mm 铅当量（IEC 61331-3:2014 标识），透视与注射时佩戴；定期做透视完整性检查。
description.en: Wrap-around lead-composite apron, 0.5 mm lead equivalent at the front (marked to IEC 61331-3:2014), worn during fluoroscopy and injections; screened for integrity periodically.

description.zh-CN: 不锈钢器械后台，双层无菌巾铺到台面以下（台面以下视为非无菌），按器械清单摆台；整台位于层流保护区内。
description.en: Stainless back table draped double to below the top (below the top is non-sterile), laid out to the tray list; the whole table sits inside the clean airflow zone.

name.zh-CN: 手术烟雾排除器（ULPA 过滤）

description.zh-CN: 外科吊塔旁的手术烟雾排除器：四级过滤（预过滤、ULPA ≥ 99.9995 % @ 0.1–0.2 µm、活性炭），电刀激发时自动启动；AORN 要求排出并过滤所有手术烟雾。
description.en: Surgical smoke evacuator beside the surgical pendant: four-stage filtration (pre-filter, ULPA ≥ 99.9995 % at 0.1–0.2 µm, activated carbon), auto-starting with electrosurgical activation; AORN: evacuate and filter all surgical smoke.

name.zh-CN: 手术清点板（RF 计数辅助）

description.zh-CN: 墙挂式清点板与 RF/条码计数系统读写器：纱布、缝针、器械在切皮前、关闭体腔前、关闭皮肤前及人员交接时清点（日本手术医学会《手术医疗实践指南》）；即使清点相符，最终清点前也用 RF 检测棒扫描患者（AORN）。
description.en: Wall count board with the RF/barcode count reader: swabs, sharps and instruments counted before incision, before closing a cavity, before skin closure and at every staff hand-over (JAOM Practice Guidelines); even when the counts reconcile, the patient is scanned with the RF wand before the final count (AORN).

name.zh-CN: 最终清点相符（RF 扫描阴性）
清点不符：寻找 / X 线
切皮前清点（洗手护士与巡回护士唱点）
name.en: Baseline count before incision (scrub and circulator aloud)

name.zh-CN: 最终清点（需 RF 扫描阴性）
name.en: Final count (needs a clear RF scan)

name.zh-CN: 报告清点不符（寻找，必要时术中 X 线）
name.en: Report a discrepancy (search; intra-operative X-ray if needed)

name.zh-CN: 找到缺失物品，重新清点
下一台手术：清空清点板

description.zh-CN: 射频检测棒：在关闭前扫描患者全身，检出遗留的 RFID 纱布；作为计数的辅助手段，即使清点相符也要扫描（AORN）。
description.en: Radio-frequency wand: swept over the patient before closure to detect a retained RFID swab — the count adjunct, used even when the counts reconcile (AORN).

description.zh-CN: 手术部立面的竖向遮阳格栅：仿木纹铝合金翼片按 0.6 m 间距排列、进深在 0.30–0.65 m 之间起伏，遮挡低角度日照与视线，同时让病房和走廊保留远景。
description.en: Vertical solar-shading screen of the operating floor: timber-look aluminium fins at 0.6 m centres whose depth undulates between 0.30 and 0.65 m, cutting low-angle sun and overlooking while keeping the view out.

description.zh-CN: 主入口的白色悬挑雨篷：28 cm 薄板、暖色木纹吊顶与嵌入式 LED 筒灯，两根细柱落在车道一侧，雨天也能从落客区一路走到门口。
description.en: Floating white entrance canopy: a 28 cm plate with a warm timber soffit and recessed LED downlights on two slender columns, so you walk from the drop-off to the door under cover.

description.zh-CN: 沿立面的悬挑连廊雨篷，把落客区和主入口连成一条有遮蔽的步道，吊顶同为暖色木纹并带 LED 筒灯。
description.en: A cantilevered walkway canopy along the facade linking the drop-off to the main entrance under cover, with the same warm timber soffit and LED downlights.

description.zh-CN: 雨篷的细钢柱。
description.en: A slender steel canopy column.

description.zh-CN: 雨篷上的 IMPF 立体字：石墨色铝字，底部暖光灯带。
description.en: The IMPF letters standing on the canopy: graphite aluminium with a warm light line below.

description.zh-CN: 入口广场的标识塔：石墨色铝板塔身、白色标识面和竖向暖光灯带。
description.en: The arrival totem: a graphite aluminium column with a white sign face and a vertical warm light line.

description.zh-CN: 耐候钢花池与木质长椅：低矮灌木、香草与座位，供患者家属在室外等候。
description.en: A corten steel planter with a timber bench: low shrubs, herbs and a seat for families waiting outside.

description.zh-CN: 1 m 高的石墨色庭院灯柱，顶部暖光。
description.en: A 1 m graphite light bollard with a warm head.

description.zh-CN: 手术部屋顶的员工花园：木平台、耐候钢花池与长椅、玻璃护栏——手术间隙可以到室外透口气（循证设计：自然与日光减轻医护疲劳）。
description.en: The staff garden on the operating department roof: a timber deck, corten planters and benches behind a glass balustrade — fresh air between cases (evidence-based design: nature and daylight reduce staff fatigue).

description.zh-CN: 屋面光伏阵列：倾斜单晶硅组件，为不间断电源和空调系统补充电力。
description.en: Rooftop photovoltaic array: tilted monocrystalline modules feeding the UPS and HVAC plant.

description.zh-CN: 屋顶直升机停机坪：15 × 15 m 抬升甲板、黄色安全区边线、白色着陆圈与 H 标、绿色边界灯和风向袋，供创伤和器官转运直达复合手术室。
description.en: Rooftop helipad: a raised 15 × 15 m deck with a yellow safety-area line, the white touchdown marking and H, green perimeter lights and a windsock — trauma and organ retrieval straight to the hybrid OR.

description.zh-CN: 屋顶设备区的铝合金百叶围护，遮挡排风机与冷却设备，从地面和直升机坪看都是整洁的屋面。
description.en: Louvred aluminium screen round the rooftop plant (exhaust fans and heat rejection), so the roof reads clean from the ground and the helipad.
